settings.execution: serial with explicit model unload before and after each model

results.notes: Reasoning case completed at 137 output tokens with strict JSON and score 100. Coder case also scored 100. Previous 128-token failure was an output-limit artifact, not a model-quality failure.

Both cases still returned HTTP 500 after Qwen was explicitly unloaded. Resident-model collision hypothesis is rejected. Error response body was not captured by the runner used for this screen, so model quality remains unscored.

comparison.operationalTradeoff: Gemma completed the same two-case screen faster overall (21.13s vs Qwen 36.54s), while Qwen achieved higher semantic quality and much higher generation throughput after load.

decision.next: Do not rerun Gemma or Qwen screening. Diagnose GPT-OSS HTTP 500 with progressively simple local API requests, then move finalists to real-project benchmark.
